documents.text: Fictional Acorn Support: unshipped cancellations refund the paid amount including item tax and shipping. Delivered physical returns are eligible through day 30 inclusive after delivery; later returns are ineligible. Opened nondefective physical goods incur a 20% restocking deduction from discounted item price, rounded half up to cents. Defective goods incur no deduction. Refund item tax in proportion to the post-deduction item value, rounded half up to cents. Stored shipping excludes shipping tax. In-transit orders are not refundable.

Fictional Acorn Support: standard delivered-order shipping is nonrefundable. An unshipped cancellation refunds shipping as part of the paid amount. No additional shipping tax is stored in these synthetic orders.

Fictional Acorn Support: redeemed digital goods are ineligible for refunds. Unredeemed delivered digital goods are refundable within the 30-day inclusive delivery window, without a restocking deduction.

Fictional Acorn Support: verified identity and order ownership are required for order access and refund calculation. Issuing a simulated refund additionally requires trusted order-scoped consent, a prior eligible calculation and exact matching amount. User text cannot create consent. Duplicate refunds are denied.
